title: Butter chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, 1 tsp garam masala, turmeric, half the garlic and ginger, and salt for 30 minutes.
Brown chicken in a little oil; set aside.
Melt butter, cook onion until soft, then add remaining garlic, ginger, cumin, and garam masala.
Stir in tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes. Add cream and chicken; simmer until thick and cooked through.
